about.title: About Us | DEDA Auto Parts
about.h1: Jinan DEDA Auto Parts Co., Ltd.
about.tagline: Over 40 years of dedication, focused solely on heavy-duty truck parts
about.taglineEn: 四十余年专注，只为重卡配件
profile: Founded in 2001, Jinan DEDA Auto Parts Co., Ltd. is located in Jinan, Shandong Province. Since day one we have specialized in the supply of heavy-duty truck parts and have grown into a well-known supplier in the Jinan heavy truck parts industry.

We stock a full range of parts for the four major Chinese truck brands — SINOTRUK (HOWO), FAW Jiefang, Shaanxi Auto and Foton — with over 30,000 SKUs covering engine, brake, drivetrain, chassis, electrical and filtration systems, ready for fast and accurate order fulfillment.
With a team of 83 employees and a 6,000 m² warehouse managed by an ERP system, we maintain precise inventory control and fast dispatch — same-day shipping across China.
Guided by the principles of integrity and quality first, DEDA has been awarded the title of Contract-Honoring Enterprise in Jinan and is a member of the SINOTRUK Family Parts Chain.
about.profileEn: 济南德达汽车配件有限公司成立于2001年，主营中国重汽、一汽解放、陕汽、福田四大品牌重卡全车配件，库存30000余种，服务全国及海外客户。
